method: Every 10 completed block read at unchanged native marked RGB positions and unmarked NIR context; actual literal pixel/asset/mask/SCL values retained. Finite human-defined visibility exceptions; no threshold/model classifier, source/imagery/raster operation or remote reread.
source_quality: All 166 points in-frame/masks255; validity is not surface truth, and SCL6 at some visually cloudy/fringe positions is not a water decision.

blocks.finding: All seven positions are clear wave-textured sea, far from the few eastern cloudlets.

West arc crosses visible submerged-reef and lagoon water; eastern arc lies in wave-textured sea. NIR makes the reef blue; there is no distinct exposed body at a centre. Dark sinuous lines continue as water-surface texture, not terrestrial boundaries.
Three bottom-frame points are clear sea east of the large submerged reef.
Sixteen eastern strip positions are clear sea; the isolated west point is water just east of the reef. Dark fine surface streaks are continuous with surrounding water texture.
The marked strip passes clear sea and water over the northern reef; blue NIR morphology supports water covering at the centres. No dry island body is established.
All 27 southern arc points lie in visible sea west/south of the submerged reef. Isolated cloudlets elsewhere do not obscure the marked arc.
Northern and southern sequences are clear sea on either side of the reef, with continuous water-surface streaks. The reef itself is separated from the centres.
All 16 western-frame strip centres are visible sea north of the reef, despite light haze farther north. No cloud blanket covers these exact positions.
Three extreme northeast positions are within valid pixels and visible sea; surface streaks continue across the frame.
The single northwest position is visible sea with wave/streak texture, with no terrestrial feature at the centre.
